g.text: The keychain is unavailable: the wallet goes offline with a reason, nothing burns, no file fallback
signing: online → locked | key_missing | wrong_key | other_home | offline_host_mode (C3 step 6, C9, C14, C16, C20; keychain spike)
the error codes below are illustrative names for C20's fixed codes; the classification is by message prefix (keychain spike)
[a prompt nobody answers (macOS ACL after an update of an ad hoc signed Node; a Linux unlock prompt)]
a late answer is discarded by request id (C14, H-035)
[Linux locked: "Couldn't access platform storage: Secret Service: unlock prompt was dismissed"]
[no Secret Service, or no session bus ("Platform failure: DBus error: ...")]
[the lease is another home's (a restored backup or a fork beside this home)]
signing · unlock_check [derives and not lease_mine] → other_home
Before the burn point nothing is lost: queued payments wait in the lane (payment Queued · sign → Queued),
open asks keep their 24 h deadline (Waiting · deadline → NotPaid). Signed or Sent payments need no key:
their stored bytes are rebroadcast and followed.
[the owner unlocks the keychain or answers the prompt]
signing locked · unlock_check [derives and lease_mine and not host_mode] → online
[the owner restores the key (host only, OD-6)]
Host mode (serve --box host) takes wallets offline on purpose: commands would run beside the key (TA-1);
signing · unlock_check [derives and lease_mine and host_mode] → offline_host_mode.
